sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Angerim is a fire-element weapon used by Lune. It scales with Luck (B), Defense (A).

sections.title: Is the Angerim Worth Using?
sections.content: Scales off Luck (B), Defense (A). A dedicated fire pick - it belongs in a build already committed to that element.
